# The MCP route table both dashboard entrypoints mount, one "<method> <path> <handler>"
# row per route in registration order. Read by
# test/test_dashboard_server_composition_contract_reach.py, which requires the table to
# equal these rows exactly. A route added, removed, renamed or moved on purpose edits
# its own row here; one row per line keeps two such changes on different lines.
